hero.subtitle: Lumen helps growing businesses protect their data, strengthen their operations, and adopt technology with clarity and confidence.
problem.title: The Challenge
problem.intro: Many growing businesses rely on digital tools every day, but security, backups, and technology decisions often evolve more slowly than the business itself.
problem.card1.title: Growth Without the Right Protection
problem.card1.desc: As your business grows, systems, data, and access become harder to manage. Without the right protections, one issue can quickly disrupt daily operations.
problem.card2.title: Unclear Priorities
problem.card2.desc: You may know there are risks, but not which ones matter most or where to start.
problem.card3.title: Technology Without a Clear Plan
problem.card3.desc: Cloud, backup, automation, and AI can all help — but without a clear plan, it is easy to invest in the wrong things.
problem.card4.title: Disconnected Tools and Workflows
problem.card4.desc: When systems and processes are disconnected, manual work increases, mistakes happen more easily, and growth becomes harder to manage.
approach.title: Our Approach
approach.lead: We don't sell fear. We build clarity and trust.
approach.card1.title: Understanding First
approach.card1.desc: Every business is different. A family-owned business has different needs than a growing tech company. We start by listening and understanding your operations, your people, and what truly matters to you.
approach.card2.title: Deep Technical Expertise
approach.card2.desc: Behind that simplicity is deep technical expertise. We bring experience from high-scale, global technology environments, combining cybersecurity, cloud, AI, and automation to deliver solutions that are both secure and practical.
approach.card3.title: Clear and Practical Approach
approach.card3.desc: Our approach is personal, transparent, and built for long-term partnership. No jargon, no pressure. Just clear, practical guidance you can rely on.
approach.pill1.desc: Every engagement starts with honesty, not a sales pitch.
approach.pill2.desc: Small by design. Every client gets senior-level attention.
approach.pill3.desc: We speak your language, literally and figuratively.
about.title: About Lumen
about.text1: Lumen is a boutique cybersecurity and technology consultancy built for businesses that want clear guidance, strong technical expertise, and a long-term partner they can trust.
about.text2: We work closely with each client to understand how their business operates, what matters most, and how technology can support it in a secure and practical way.
services.title: How We Help
services.healthcheck.title: Business Security Health Check
services.healthcheck.desc: A practical review of your business security, systems, access, and backups — delivered as a clear report with prioritized next steps.
services.healthcheck.bullet1: Clear understanding of your current setup
services.healthcheck.bullet2: Key risks explained in simple terms
services.healthcheck.bullet4: Practical recommendations tailored to your business
services.data.title: Data Protection and Backup
services.data.desc: We help protect your business data with reliable backup and recovery solutions that fit the way you work.
services.cloud.title: Cloud Guidance
services.cloud.desc: From first steps to better structure, we help you use cloud technology in a way that is secure, practical, and right for your business.
services.ai.title: AI & Automation
services.ai.desc: We help you use AI and automation where it creates real value — reducing manual work and improving day-to-day efficiency.
services.cyber.title: Cybersecurity
services.cyber.desc: We help strengthen your security, reduce everyday risk, and respond more confidently when issues arise.
why.title: Why Lumen
why.expertise.title: Senior Expertise, Without the Noise
why.expertise.desc: We bring deep technical experience from global technology environments, delivered in a way that is clear, practical, and easy to act on.
why.community.title: Built for the Way You Operate
why.community.desc: We understand how growing and family-run businesses work, and we tailor our approach to fit your reality.
why.partners.title: A Long-Term Partner You Can Rely On
why.partners.desc: We focus on building long-term relationships, helping you improve and adapt as your business evolves.
howwework.title: How We Work
multilingual.title: We Speak Your Language
multilingual.text: Clear communication in English, Arabic, and Hebrew — so you can fully understand your technology and make confident decisions.
